name: Leon Cardoza
source:
A good friend of Arthur and Hana in the past. A boy of Russian descent whose mother is British and father is Russian.

A playboy wannabe who recently came back from his 2-year trip to Russia for family business.

Not much is known about his personal life. Arthur and Leon may be best friends, but they keep their stories to themselves. For good reasons.
